'''Osos Niskooen''' was a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] who was a member of the soldier caste during the [[Battle of Roche]]. He acted as a guide for [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], but his thorax was split during the battle, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
